minutes.headline: Assessors agreed the RFP terms for a contract assessor and set a Monday 1 p.m. meeting to review a parallel job description.
minutes.summary: The remote Board of Assessors went through the draft RFP for a one-year contract Assessor: qualifications, a minimum of 40 hours a week with at least 32 on-site, vacation wording, new growth timing and evaluation criteria. They also agreed to advertise the RFP and, in parallel, create a job posting and position description needing Personnel Committee approval. The board noted the abatement deadline extension to June 1 and agreed to meet again Monday.

budget_items.what_was_said: The contract needed signatures from board members; the chair had already signed.
Letters were sent to applicants extending decision dates to June 1; most returned. State act lets selectmen extend abatement and tax deadlines.
The firm doing personal property has increased billable amounts well beyond earlier levels.
A new position would need Town Meeting approval and placement in the salary grid; money could already be in place for a July start.

what_happened.line: The Board of Assessors agreed to issue the RFP for a one-year contract Assessor as drafted, and to prepare a job posting in parallel.
The RFP wording sets a 40-hour week with at least 32 hours overseeing daily office functions, and a minimum number of weeks of service.
The board adjusted the evaluation criteria numbers and agreed to add an interview step for top-ranked proposers.
The board noted that abatement decision dates were extended to June 1 by letter, and that a new position would need Town Meeting approval and a place in the salary grid.
The board set a Zoom meeting for Monday at 1 p.m., with the agenda posted before the deadline.

why_it_matters: The town is filling its chief assessing role through a contract, which touches how property values and abatement requests are handled, and a permanent position would need Town Meeting approval and a salary grid placement, so residents may be asked to vote on it.
watch_next: The Board of Assessors meets again Monday at 1 p.m. by Zoom to review the parallel job description.
The job posting and position description go to the Personnel Committee for review.
